office_does: The county clerk is clerk of the superior court, keeping its filings, dockets and case records.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Clerk Kriston Chapman, in office since 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Columbia County Clerk since 2022 and a former chief deputy clerk and District Court administrator, running unopposed.
highlights: County Clerk since 2022; earlier deputy clerk in Benton and Walla Walla counties [S1]
Cites a new e-filing system and cleanup of older records [S1]
